text-align: center; font-size: 12px !important; color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.div:
OUTPUT — Definition: Target variable to predict; multiple outputs are potentially correlated.
Example: Simultaneously predicting patient weight and body fat mass.

div.style: text-align: center; font-size: 12px !important; color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.div:
TASK — Definition: Distinct realization of (at least) one underlying pattern, shared across all tasks.
Example: In a hospital database, each patient is modeled as an individual task.

div.style: text-align: center; font-size: 15px !important; color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px;
text-align: center; font-size: 12px !important; color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.div:
CLUSTER — Definition: Subgroup of tasks sharing similar curve dynamics (trend, amplitude, smoothness). Shared jointly across all outputs.
Example: Latent male vs. female physiological response profiles.

div.style: text-align: center; font-size: 12px !important; color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.div:
CHANNEL — Definition: A specific output dimension. Information transfer across channels is governed by the task mixture.
Example: 2D vehicle trajectory coordinates over time (X and Y coordinates represent two channels).
